text:
I need to verify if Ted Cassidy voiced Gomez Addams in the Hanna-Barbera animated series of The Addams Family.

The Hanna-Barbera animated series "The Addams Family" aired in 1973. In this series, John Astin (who played Gomez in the live-action TV series) provided the voice of Gomez Addams, not Ted Cassidy. Ted Cassidy voiced Lurch in both the original live-action series and reprised that role in the animated series.

Verdict: INCORRECT
Confidence: 0.95
